plan.subject: Adolescent depression

plan.coverage_notes: This plan covers the clinician's core interests in evidence-based psychotherapies (CBT, IPT-A, mindfulness, family-based), digital interventions, pharmacotherapy (SSRIs, combination), assessment/screening, school prevention, and implementation science. It includes 2-3 broad, recall-safety queries (IDs 1, 13, 15) to ensure sufficient corpus size. Angles deliberately skipped per the profile include neuroimaging, biomarkers, pure developmental neuroscience, and adult depression research not applied to adolescents.
